name: Sakurazuka Natsuki
source:
This is the same [url=/c10013]Natsuki Sakurazuka[/url], only younger. She looked like this in the year of 1999. 
On the other hand, her personality is slightly different from that of the present time because she is more reserved and timid.

[spoiler]She jumps on [url=https://vndb.org/c10020]Tsukumo[/url]'s neck the day of his arrival by calling him "Oni-chan". Knowing she misunderstands, Tsukumo - on the verge of being called her "Nee-san" - pretends not to know her, which makes her deeply sad. Tsukumo will finish in her class as a transferred student.

[url=https://vndb.org/c10022]Kuurin[/url] makes her believe that Tsukumo has lost his memory.
She often comforts with Kuurin who seems to be her best friend and her confidante. She already told her about her "Onii-chan".

Even if Tsukumo is supposed to have lost his memory, she will pretend in front of her whole class that she is his girlfriend.
Some time after Kuurin will try to rob her romantic interest ( she can get there depending on the route chosen ).

The trait corresponding to the state of her virginity have a value that varies according to the temporal line and the parallel dimension born as a result of a minor or major temporal change.[/spoiler]

She is described by her classmates as the most beautiful and kind girl in high school. The boys also call her "untouchable beauty" because she rejects all boys when they confess.

This heroine has [url=/c10025]another alternative version[/url] (from when she were even younger, in the year of 1996).
